tasks.name: Define preliminary control and safety concept
tasks.description: Sets the early automation concept (DCS/SIS/F&G split, level of automation, control room location, remote operation) for screening and estimating.

needs.info: Operating and automation philosophy preferences, manning, remote operation, approved vendor and standards list
Block flow diagram and configuration options with main unit operations
Design basis outline and FEL deliverable list

tasks.name: Prepare factored instrument count and I&C estimate input
tasks.description: Estimates instrument counts, I/O, control valves, analyzers and system cabinets from PFDs or P&IDs to feed the cost estimate.

needs.info: PFDs / preliminary P&IDs: equipment count, control loops, streams with analyzers
Preliminary control and safety system concept (INST-I010)
Estimate basis, class, cut-off date and WBS/CBS structure
Plot plan area sizes for cable and JB factors

tasks.name: Develop ICS architecture and control/rack room requirements
tasks.description: Develops the ICS network architecture and defines control room, rack room and field equipment room requirements including cabinet layouts and heat loads.

needs.info: Preliminary control and safety system concept (INST-I010)
Cyber security requirements, site network standards, interfaces to existing plant DCS and historian
Control building and rack room layout, floor space, raised floor/cable entry, HVAC capability
UPS location and distribution boards serving control system rooms
I/O counts per system (INST-I261) for cabinet counts
Packaged equipment list with control system type (PLC, local panel) and communication interfaces

tasks.name: Write I&C design basis and general instrument specifications
tasks.description: Writes the I&C design basis, instrument selection guide and general specifications for field instruments, installation and wiring.

needs.info: Owner standards, preferred vendors, spares philosophy, electrical/instrument codes
Project design basis and applicable codes, units of measure
Hazardous area classification approach and protection concepts (Ex d / Ex i)
Site ambient conditions, fire and gas detection philosophy
Piping material classes and connection standards for instrument process connections

tasks.name: Review P&IDs for instrumentation and controls
tasks.description: Reviews and marks up P&IDs for instrument types, tagging, control and interlock representation, valve failure positions and instrument connections.

needs.info: P&IDs (process content) at IFR/IFD with loops, interlocks, valve fail positions
Control and operating philosophy
HAZOP actions affecting instruments and interlocks

tasks.name: Build and maintain the instrument index in SI
tasks.description: Creates instrument tags and loops in SI from the P&IDs and keeps the index aligned with each P&ID revision.

needs.info: P&ID instrument tags, loop numbers, service, line or equipment, P&ID number (SPID and SI not linked: tags re-created by hand)
Line list: line number, size, spec for instrument location
Equipment list: equipment numbers and services
Package scope split: which instruments are vendor supplied
I&C P&ID markups (INST-I045) to confirm tagging

tasks.name: Close out HAZOP and LOPA actions on I&C design
tasks.description: Responds to HAZOP and LOPA actions assigned to I&C (added transmitters, alarms, trips, SIF changes) and updates the design.

needs.info: HAZOP and LOPA action register with actions assigned to I&C
Revised P&IDs reflecting accepted actions

tasks.name: Enter instrument process data
tasks.description: Enters process conditions for each instrument into SI process data sheets from process datasheets and the HYSYS stream summary.

needs.info: HYSYS stream data: flow min/norm/max, P, T, density, viscosity, MW, Cp/Cv, Z, vapour pressure (no link: copied by hand)
Instrument process datasheets / process data requests: ranges, set points, alarm and trip settings
Line list: design P/T, fluid, phase
Piping material classes: line rating and material for instrument wetted parts

tasks.name: Size control valves
tasks.description: Sizes control valves for all cases, checks noise, cavitation and flashing, and selects body size, trim, rating and actuator.

needs.info: Instrument process data in SI (INST-I060)
Control valve allowable pressure drop and flow cases from hydraulic calcs
Line size and pipe class at the valve, reducer arrangement
Noise limits for the plant

tasks.name: Size on/off and emergency shutdown valves and actuators
tasks.description: Sizes on/off, ESD and blowdown valves and specifies actuators, stroke times, failure positions and leak classes.

needs.info: Instrument process data in SI (INST-I060)
Required closing/opening times, fail positions, blowdown orifice and depressuring requirements
Fire-safe and emergency isolation valve requirements from fire protection study
SRS (INST-I220) for SIF final element requirements

tasks.name: Calculate flow elements and thermowells
tasks.description: Sizes orifice plates and other flow elements and checks thermowell wake frequency.

needs.info: Instrument process data in SI (INST-I060)
Line size, schedule and internal diameter

tasks.name: Prepare relief valve datasheets
tasks.description: Prepares PSV datasheets from the process relief cases and selects orifice, body size and rating.

needs.info: Relief load summary: governing case, relieving rate, set pressure, back pressure, fluid properties (copied by hand)
Flare/relief header hydraulics: built-up back pressure and inlet loss checks
Inlet/outlet piping class and rating

tasks.name: Prepare instrument datasheets
tasks.description: Prepares SI datasheets for transmitters, switches, gauges, flow meters, level instruments and valves ready for requisition.

needs.info: Instrument process data in SI (INST-I060)
Control valve and on/off valve sizing (INST-I070, INST-I080)
I&C design basis and specs (INST-I040)
Hazardous area classification drawings: zone, gas group, temperature class at instrument location
Piping material class: wetted part material, flange rating, facing

tasks.name: Define instrument connections on equipment and lines
tasks.description: Defines instrument nozzles and connections on vessels, columns, tanks and lines (level bridles, thermowells, pressure tappings).

needs.info: Vessel and column datasheets and GA drawings: nozzle schedule, elevations, internals
Normal/high/low liquid levels and interface levels
Piping branch connection standards

tasks.name: Prepare instrument material requisitions
tasks.description: Compiles material requisitions for instrument packages (control valves, on/off valves, PSVs, transmitters, flow, analyzers, F&G devices, bulks).

needs.info: Instrument datasheets (INST-I110) and relief valve datasheets (INST-I100)
Requisition template, commercial terms and bidders list
Vendor document requirements (VDRL) and procurement schedule

tasks.name: Evaluate instrument bids technically
tasks.description: Evaluates vendor technical offers against the requisition and issues the technical bid evaluation.

needs.info: Technical offers: deviations, model codes, sizing confirmation, delivery
Bid package and clarification log

tasks.name: Review instrument vendor data
tasks.description: Reviews vendor drawings and data for instruments and valves and loads certified data into SI.

needs.info: Vendor drawings and data: dimensional drawings, sizing confirmation, wiring, certificates
PO and expediting status for vendor document due dates

tasks.name: Specify analyzers and analyzer shelters
tasks.description: Specifies process and environmental analyzers, sample systems and analyzer shelters.

needs.info: Analyzer requirements: stream, components, ranges, response time, sample conditions
Emissions monitoring (CEMS) requirements from permits
Sample point locations and plot space

tasks.name: Write control narratives and functional design specifications
tasks.description: Turns the process control philosophy into control narratives and functional logic for complex loops, sequences and permissives.

needs.info: Control and operating philosophy, control loop descriptions, start-up/shutdown sequences
Rotating equipment and package control requirements (anti-surge, permissives)

tasks.name: Prepare DCS specification
tasks.description: Writes the DCS functional and hardware specification for the main automation contractor.

needs.info: ICS architecture (INST-I030)
I/O counts per system (INST-I261)
Owner DCS standards, graphics standards, cyber security requirements

tasks.name: Prepare SIS specification
tasks.description: Writes the SIS hardware and software specification consistent with the SRS.

needs.info: Safety requirements specification (INST-I220)
I/O counts per system (INST-I261)
SIL determination results: number of SIFs and SIL targets

tasks.name: Specify fire and gas system and device list
tasks.description: Specifies the F&G system and builds the F&G detector and device list from the F&G mapping study.

needs.info: F&G mapping study: detector types, coverage, locations, voting
Fire and gas philosophy and fire zones
Hazardous area classification for detector Ex rating
Building layouts for building smoke/heat detection

tasks.name: Define SIFs and input to SIL determination
tasks.description: Defines SIF initiators, logic and final elements and provides instrument reliability input to the LOPA/SIL determination.

needs.info: Interlock and trip list with trip settings and actions
LOPA scenarios and required risk reduction

tasks.name: Write safety requirements specification
tasks.description: Writes the SRS for each SIF covering safe state, response time, trip points, bypasses and proof test requirements.

needs.info: SIF list (INST-I210)
SIL determination report with SIL targets and assumptions
Process safety time, trip settings

tasks.name: Verify SIL achievement
tasks.description: Calculates PFDavg and architectural constraints for each SIF using selected device data and sets proof test intervals.

needs.info: SRS (INST-I220)
Device failure rate data / SIL certificates (FMEDA) for transmitters, logic solver, valves
Plant turnaround interval and maintenance constraints

tasks.name: Prepare cause and effect charts
tasks.description: Prepares the process shutdown and F&G cause and effect charts.

needs.info: Interlock and shutdown philosophy and trip list
SIF list (INST-I210)
F&G philosophy: fire zones, voting, executive actions
Motor and electrical trip interfaces (MCC trip points)

tasks.name: Rationalize alarms and build master alarm database
tasks.description: Runs alarm rationalization and records alarm set points, priorities and consequences.

needs.info: Alarm set points and operating envelopes
Alarm philosophy and operator input
Instrument index (INST-I050)

tasks.name: Develop I/O list and assign I/O
tasks.description: Builds the I/O list per system, assigns I/O to cabinets and cards and issues I/O counts to system vendors.

needs.info: Instrument index (INST-I050)
Motor control signals per drive: start/stop/run/trip, hardwired vs serial (SPEL not linked)
Package interface signal list

tasks.name: Integrate vendor package controls
tasks.description: Defines package I&C requirements for mechanical requisitions and reviews package control data and interfaces.

needs.info: Package requisitions and vendor data: P&IDs, instrument lists, PLC/panel data
Package instrument list, control narratives, communication maps (Modbus/Ethernet)

tasks.name: Compile instrument utility loads
tasks.description: Compiles instrument power, UPS, instrument air and heat tracing requirements.

needs.info: Instrument index (INST-I050) and system cabinet data (INST-I031)
Analyzer and system power consumption data

tasks.name: Prepare instrument location plans and JB locations
tasks.description: Places instruments and JBs in the 3D model, prepares location plans and comments in model reviews.

needs.info: Routed piping 3D model and plot plan
Structural model: platforms, supports
Cable tray routing and hazardous area classification drawings

tasks.name: Prepare hook-up drawings and assign typicals
tasks.description: Prepares process, pneumatic and electrical installation hook-ups with bills of material and assigns each instrument tag to a hook-up typical.

needs.info: Instrument index and datasheets: instrument type, process connection, mounting (INST-I050, INST-I110)
Piping material class: root valve type, branch size and rating at instrument take-offs
Process conditions needing special hook-ups (sour, hydrogen, steam, cryogenic, viscous) from line list
Instrument heat tracing requirements (INST-I281)

tasks.name: Design instrument wiring, marshalling and terminations
tasks.description: Designs field JB wiring, marshalling and system cabinet terminations and cable block diagrams in SI.

needs.info: I/O list with cabinet/card/channel assignment (INST-I260)
JB locations and sizes (INST-I291)
System vendor cabinet arrangement, marshalling terminal numbering, IS barrier/isolator types
MCC interposing relay and terminal designations for motor signals (SPEL not linked)

tasks.name: Prepare instrument cable schedule and tray loading
tasks.description: Prepares the instrument cable schedule with lengths from the routed model and gives cable counts per route to electrical for tray sizing.

needs.info: Wiring and termination diagrams (INST-I310)
Cable tray and trench layout with route segments and segregation rules
3D model distances for cable length take-off

tasks.name: Generate loop diagrams
tasks.description: Generates loop diagrams in SI from field device through JB and marshalling to system channel.

needs.info: Wiring diagrams and cable schedule (INST-I310, INST-I320)
System vendor final I/O assignment and terminal numbers after FAT
Certified instrument wiring data from vendor review (INST-I151)

tasks.name: Prepare instrument bulk MTO
tasks.description: Calculates bulk quantities (cable, tubing, fittings, JBs, glands, supports, cable tray branches) for purchase and site issue.

needs.info: Hook-up bills of material and assignments (INST-I300)
Instrument cable schedule (INST-I320) and JB list (INST-I291)
Stock codes and surplus allowances

tasks.name: Design telecom, CCTV and security systems
tasks.description: Designs PA/GA, CCTV, plant LAN/WAN, radio and access control systems and places devices.

needs.info: Building layouts and fence/gate locations
Security assessment, alarm audibility and PA/GA zoning from F&G and emergency response
Site telecom standards and connection to existing networks
Hazardous area classification for field device Ex rating

tasks.name: Prepare system configuration data for vendors
tasks.description: Exports tag, range, alarm and I/O data from SI and the alarm database to the DCS/SIS/F&G vendors for configuration.

needs.info: Instrument index, process data and I/O list (INST-I050, INST-I060, INST-I260)
Master alarm database (INST-I250)
Control narratives and C&E (INST-I170, INST-I240, INST-I241)
P&IDs IFC for graphics

tasks.name: Review configuration and witness system FAT
tasks.description: Reviews graphics and logic configuration and witnesses DCS, SIS and F&G factory acceptance tests.

needs.info: FAT procedures, configured system, graphics and logic printouts
C&E charts and control narratives (INST-I240, INST-I241, INST-I170)
Operations attendance and graphics acceptance

tasks.name: Answer construction RFIs and issue I&C field changes
tasks.description: Answers I&C RFIs and technical queries from site and issues field change instructions.

needs.info: RFIs with field markups on location plans, hook-ups, cable routes
Late vendor data changes affecting installation

tasks.name: Prepare instrument tag register for completions
tasks.description: Exports the instrument, cable and JB register with system/subsystem assignment for loading into Smart Completions.

needs.info: System and subsystem boundaries (systemization) with marked-up P&IDs
Instrument index, cable schedule, JB list (INST-I050, INST-I320, INST-I291)

tasks.name: Support loop checks and resolve I&C punch
tasks.description: Supports calibration and loop checks and gives engineering responses to I&C punch items.

needs.info: Loop check records, calibration ITRs and punch items
Loop diagrams IFC (INST-I330)

tasks.name: Support SAT, SIS validation and integrated testing
tasks.description: Supports site acceptance tests, SIS functional validation against the SRS and integrated C&E tests.

needs.info: SAT and integrated test procedures, commissioning sequence
SRS and proof test procedures (INST-I220, INST-I231)

tasks.name: Prepare as-built I&C database and drawings
tasks.description: Incorporates as-built redlines and final vendor data into SI and I&C drawings for handover.

needs.info: As-built redlines on loop, wiring, location and hook-up drawings
Final certified data books and calibration certificates
Closed punch and field changes

items.name: Preliminary control and safety system concept
items.content: DCS/SIS/F&G split, level of automation, central vs local control room, fieldbus or conventional I/O, packaged unit control approach, basis for estimate.

items.name: I&C quantities and estimate input
items.content: Instrument counts by type, I/O counts by system, control valve and on/off valve counts by size class, analyzer count, cabinet count, bulk factors (cable m per I/O, JBs), allowances.

items.name: ICS architecture diagram
items.content: DCS, SIS, F&G, PLCs, historian, engineering stations, network switches, firewalls, serial/Ethernet links to packages, redundancy, time sync, remote I/O locations.

items.name: Control and rack room space, cabinet layout and heat loads
items.content: Cabinet count and footprint, consoles, cable entry, cabinet heat dissipation (kW) for HVAC, floor loading, clean power needs per room.

items.name: I&C design basis and general instrument specifications
items.content: Instrument selection rules, signal standards (4-20 mA/HART, fieldbus), Ex protection, enclosure ratings, process connection standards, tubing/cable specs, color coding, approved vendor list.

items.name: I&C P&ID markups
items.content: Instrument tag numbers, instrument types and symbols, signal lines, interlock and SIS boundaries, fail positions, instrument connection sizes, comments for PROC to incorporate.

items.name: Instrument index
items.content: Tag, instrument type, service, loop, P&ID, line/equipment number, I/O type, system (DCS/SIS/F&G/package), supply scope, status and revision.

items.name: I&C HAZOP/LOPA action responses
items.content: Action number, response, design change made (tags added/changed, alarm/trip settings), evidence and closure request.

items.name: Instrument process data in SI
items.content: Per tag: fluid, phase, operating and design P/T, flow cases, density, viscosity, MW, range, alarm and trip points, line size and class.

items.name: Control valve sizing calculations
items.content: Cv per case, % opening, noise dB(A), cavitation/flashing check, trim type, actuator sizing, shut-off class.

items.name: Control valve sizes and ratings for P&ID
items.content: Body size, ANSI rating, reducer sizes, Cv selected, fail action and leak class for PROC to show on P&IDs and in hydraulics.

items.name: Preliminary in-line valve dimensions and weights
items.content: Face-to-face, end connection, estimated weight, actuator height and orientation envelope for control and on/off valves for piping layout.

items.name: On/off and ESD valve sizing and actuator data
items.content: Valve type, size, rating, shut-off class, stroke time, failure position, actuator torque/thrust, air supply, fire-proofing, partial stroke testing.

items.name: Flow element and thermowell calculations
items.content: Beta ratio, bore, differential, permanent pressure loss, uncertainty; thermowell wake frequency results and lengths.

items.name: Flow element sizes and straight-run requirements
items.content: Flow element type, size, rating, flange taps, required upstream/downstream straight lengths and permanent pressure loss for PIPE layout and PROC hydraulics.

items.name: Relief valve datasheets
items.content: Tag, set pressure, relieving rate, required/selected orifice, inlet/outlet size and rating, body/trim material, bellows/pilot, back pressure.

items.name: Instrument datasheets for requisition
items.content: Per tag specification: process data, range, materials, process connection, Ex rating, enclosure, signal, accessories.

items.name: Instrument connection requirements on equipment and piping
items.content: Per instrument: connection type, size, rating, orientation, elevation/level range, bridle arrangement; for MECH nozzle schedule and PIPE branch tables.

items.name: Instrument material requisitions
items.content: MR per instrument package: technical scope, datasheets, quantities, spares, VDRL, inspection and test requirements.

items.name: Instrument technical bid evaluations
items.content: Compliance table, technical clarifications, deviations accepted, technically acceptable bidders, recommended vendor.

items.name: Instrument vendor data comments
items.content: Return code (1-4) and comments on vendor drawings, sizing, materials, certificates.

items.name: Certified in-line instrument dimensions and weights
items.content: Certified face-to-face, end connections, weights, actuator envelopes, centre of gravity for control valves, on/off valves, flow meters and PSVs for PIPE model and stress.

items.name: Analyzer datasheets and system specification
items.content: Analyzer type, components, ranges, sample conditioning, calibration gases, shelter scope.

items.name: Analyzer shelter utility and space requirements
items.content: Shelter size, weight, location, power and UPS, HVAC, instrument air, sample return and vent connections, calibration gas storage.

items.name: Control narratives and functional logic
items.content: Loop-by-loop control descriptions, cascade/ratio/split-range logic, sequences, permissives, overrides for DCS configuration.

items.name: DCS specification
items.content: Hardware, software, redundancy, I/O counts with spare, graphics, historian, cyber security, FAT/SAT requirements.

items.name: SIS specification
items.content: Certified logic solver, SIL capability, redundancy, I/O counts, bypass/override management, sequence of events, interface to DCS.

items.name: F&G system specification
items.content: F&G logic solver, voting, alarm annunciation, interfaces to fire water, HVAC shutdown, PA/GA.

items.name: F&G device list and locations
items.content: Detector tag, type, fire zone, coordinates/elevation, voting group, Ex rating, I/O type.

items.name: SIF list with initiators and final elements
items.content: SIF number, initiator tags, voting, logic, final element tags, safe state, response time, target SIL.

items.name: Safety requirements specification
items.content: Per SIF: description, safe state, SIL, response time, trip set points, demand mode, bypass rules, reset, proof test interval, spurious trip rate target.

items.name: SIL verification report
items.content: PFDavg, RRF, HFT and SFF per SIF, assumptions, compliance with target SIL.

items.name: Proof test intervals and procedures
items.content: Proof test interval, coverage and test steps per SIF for operations and commissioning.

items.name: Process shutdown cause and effect
items.content: Causes (tags, set points) versus effects (valves, motors, alarms) with shutdown levels and SIF references.

items.name: F&G cause and effect
items.content: Detector voting by fire zone versus executive actions (ESD, deluge, HVAC, PA/GA, isolation).

items.name: Master alarm database
items.content: Tag, alarm type, set point, priority, cause, consequence, operator action, response time.

items.name: I/O list
items.content: Tag, signal type, system, cabinet, card, channel, IS/non-IS, SIL, spare.

items.name: I/O counts and typicals for system vendors
items.content: I/O count per system and type, redundancy, spare percentage, typical circuits for DCS/SIS/F&G vendors.

items.name: Package instrumentation and control requirements
items.content: I&C scope for packages: instrument standards, PLC requirements, interface signals, communications, F&G and SIS interfaces.

items.name: Package control vendor data comments
items.content: Comments on package P&IDs, instrument lists, panel drawings and communication maps.

items.name: Package interface signal list
items.content: Hardwired and serial signals between packages and DCS/SIS/F&G: tag, register, type, direction.

items.name: Instrument power and UPS load list
items.content: Consumer, voltage, kW/kVA, UPS or normal supply, redundancy, location for ELEC load list and UPS sizing (keyed into SPEL by hand).

items.name: Instrument winterization and heat tracing requirements
items.content: Instrument tags, impulse lines and analyzer sample lines needing tracing, maintain temperature, enclosure heating.

items.name: Instrument air consumers
items.content: Instrument air users and steady/peak consumption for PROC utility balance and MECH air package sizing.

items.name: Instrument location plans
items.content: Plan views with instrument and JB locations and elevations, tray routing.

items.name: Junction box locations and sizes
items.content: JB tag, coordinates, size, IS/non-IS, cables served.

items.name: 3D model review comments for I&C
items.content: Instrument access, valve orientation, clearance and maintainability comments.

items.name: Hook-up drawings and tag assignments
items.content: Process, pneumatic and electrical hook-up typicals with bill of materials (tubing, fittings, manifolds, supports) and tag-to-hook-up assignment list.

items.name: Wiring, marshalling and termination diagrams
items.content: JB and marshalling cabinet termination diagrams, multicore/single-pair allocation, cable block diagrams, IS/non-IS segregation.

items.name: Instrument cable schedule
items.content: Cable tag, type, cores/pairs, size, from/to (device, JB, cabinet), route segments, length, gland type; for construction pulling and MTO.

items.name: Instrument cable routing and tray loading requirements
items.content: Instrument cable count, overall diameter and weight per tray segment, IS/signal segregation, for ELEC raceway sizing.

items.name: Loop diagrams
items.content: Loop from field device to system channel: terminals, cables, JBs, power, IS parameters, ranges, set points; used for loop checks.

items.name: Instrument bulk MTO
items.content: Quantities and specs of cable by type, tubing, fittings, manifolds, JBs, glands, supports, with surplus, for requisition and Jovix material control.

items.name: Telecom system design
items.content: PA/GA, CCTV, LAN/WAN, radio and access control specifications, block diagrams and requisition data.

items.name: Telecom device list, locations and power
items.content: Speaker, beacon, camera, access point and reader tags with locations, mounting, power/UPS load and cabling needs.

items.name: System configuration database
items.content: Tag, description, range, units, alarm limits and priorities, I/O assignment, control module typical, for DCS/SIS/F&G configuration (spreadsheet export to vendor tools).

items.name: FAT report and punch list
items.content: FAT test record, punch items by category, configuration changes required, release for shipment.

items.name: I&C RFI responses and field changes
items.content: RFI answers, field change instructions with revised hook-up, routing or termination details.

items.name: Instrument tag register for completions
items.content: Instrument, cable, JB and loop tags with type, system, subsystem, ITR form type, for spreadsheet load into Smart Completions.

items.name: I&C punch and loop check resolutions
items.content: Engineering responses to loop check failures and punch items, range/set point corrections.

items.name: SAT and SIS validation records and as-configured database
items.content: SAT results, SIF validation records, final as-configured database backup and change log.

items.name: As-built I&C database and drawings
items.content: As-built instrument index, datasheets, loops, wiring and location drawings for owner handover.
